item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02020","case1_error":"Uses first-day total flowers as tulips, counting the 20 roses again when calculating revenue.","case2_error":"Subtracts the $200 already won twice from the puppy's cost.","reason":"Both account for an already included component again: first-day roses in revenue and prior winnings in the remaining cost.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02021","case1_error":"Adds overlapping purchase options, charging for 14 individual balloons plus 20 packaged balloons instead of 14 balloons total.","case2_error":"Adds the lightsaber cost again after including it in the $3000 total.","reason":"Both add overlapping costs as though they were separate necessary expenditures, counting the same required purchase more than once.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02022","case1_error":"Reverses the cutting chronology and subtracts both cuts; the question also ambiguously identifies the boards and their lengths.","case2_error":"Uses 60 degrees instead of 240 as the cooling starting temperature, then takes the absolute value.","reason":"The wood question is materially ambiguous: cutting equal amounts from unequal boards cannot equalize them, and the requested boards are unclear.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02023","case1_error":"States correct total and division formulas, then supplies unsupported 6186; the formulas yield 859.","case2_error":"States the correct remaining-biscuits expression, then supplies unsupported 30; the expression yields 40.","reason":"Both append an incorrect final number after correct formulas without showing a numerical evaluation that explains the discrepancy.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02024","case1_error":"Evaluates the correctly written calorie sum as 2175 instead of 1975.","case2_error":"Incorrectly converts half a ton to 500 pounds and supplies 15 bags, unsupported even by its own formula.","reason":"The first explicitly miscalculates a correct expression. The second uses an incorrect unit conversion and an unsupported final number.","judgment":"different"}]}
